base_model: nreimers/mMiniLMv2-L6-H384-distilled-from-XLMR-Large (6 layers, hidden 384, 12 heads, XLM-R tokenizer, 250,002 tokens)
pooling: mean over tokens, dropout 0.1, three linear heads
optimiser: AdamW lr 6e-5, weight decay 0.01, 200 warm-up steps then linear decay, grad clip 1.0
augmentation: artist blanked p=0.2, duration unknown p=0.25 (re-drawn each epoch)
data: same training rows as the linear model (21,377 after guards) + 9,000 artist-name rows for the genre head = 30,377 examples
